judgment_text:
ORDER

Seeking a direction to the respondents to regularise the service of the petitioner as a Data Entry Operator or in any other suitable posts, by taking note of petitioners uninterrupted service from the year 1998 by reconsidering G.O. Ms.(ID) No. 87, dated 01.03.2018, in the light of the order passed in W.P.(MD). No. 20673 of 2016 dated 25.02.2020 by considering the representation of the petitioner dated 28.03.2026, this writ petition is filed.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that similar matters are already considered by this Court and favourble orders are passed and the petitioner also stands on the same footing and sought indulgence of this Court.

3. In view of the above, the 2nd respondent is directed to consider the petitioner's representation dated 28.03.2026 and dispose of the same within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order in the light of the order passed in W.P.(MD).No. 20673 of 2016 dated 25.02.2020.

4. In the result, this Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs.
